svg.title: Resource retirement workflow
svg.desc: Disposal fences and detaches before observation. An undo-retained resource receives fake-user protection; otherwise an eligible resource is evicted, rechecked, and removed, while protected or in-use resources are retained.

g.text: opt fence succeeded or ordinary retirement
loop [fence, detach; stop if fence fails]
failed observation or live and ineligible

text.tspan: advance only on an authorizing receipt

g.text: terminal; removal only if fresh recheck eligible
